verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE clearly captures incident timelines automatically (alerts, Slack chat, and generates an automated post-mortem from the incident timeline and Slack per docs-9), and incidents can be acknowledged/resolved directly from Slack (docs-3), showing action capture too. However, there is no evidence of a post-incident editing or annotation feature for the timeline itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of editing/annotating the captured timeline after the fact, and any UI/workflow for manual annotation.
